item.title: Wed, Sep 30 · 7:45 PM – 10:00 PM — Nude Figure Drawing at Unkindness Art
item.description: Location: Unkindness Art, 2923 North Avenue, Richmond, VA 23222 | Cost: $10 | Ongoing nude figure drawing series (18+ only, valid photo ID required at door) on the last Wednesday of every month, 7:45-10pm. September session is a short-pose session with a single model. Tickets nonrefundable and must be purchased in advance; no guaranteed door tickets. Late entry not allowed once session starts at 8pm.
